 Count slowly to 30 using the shell: a loop that prints each number with sleep 1 between them.


 The user wants a loop counting to 30 with sleep 1. That takes 30 seconds. Just run it.


 $ for i in $(seq 1 30); do echo $i; sleep 1; done (timeout 60s)
